items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He was in that great band that Lucky had back there in the thirties when he had -- Andy Gibson was in the band, Sweets Edison was in the band, Charlie Shavers.

ctx.x: Oh, Charlie Shavers, I don't even talk about him. You put Charlie Shavers up there and then talk about the other trumpet players. That's the way I feel about him. He was fantastic. To me he was one of the greatest all-around trumpet players that ever lived. To me. That's my idea of him, you know. There's an album of (unintelligible) the genius of Charlie Shavers.
Si Oliver did the arrangements on that?
